test_title: PYST 66: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A+ B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A − B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’

Based on the above, how is R related to U if ‘U − P × Q ÷ R + S − T’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 –
 ×

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife

 to B
 
 

Given: U − P × Q ÷ R + S − T

U − P → U is the brother of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecc7f8e93a765e03ae7dd4687e52ebc375a60f0ee4984ad5749b830727ad2ea3.png] 

P × Q → P is the wife of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a73191dc7a3b910b701fd8cee040a2ea4a90051eb232e1acc08ab8910a87380b.png] 

Q ÷ R → Q is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8f5f8f2a66a3e6ac6685b46c279ae179bc4e05be8754cad4b7c6603e8c94be7.png] 

R + S → R is the mother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46ab8a1ed65dd0797d269177522dcc0925e904fda5679ce73ae064a01bad118c.png] 

S − T → S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40add3dd4056a207442fc5832cfd442566451c044e9888adbe00eab69bd3f689.png] 

Thus, R is U's niece or sister's daughter.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
